application_credentials.description:
Tesla OAuth requires a developer application Client ID and Client Secret.

1. Create an application at [Tesla Developer]({developer_url}).
2. Set **Allowed Redirect URI** to `{redirect_url}`.
3. Copy the Client ID and Client Secret here.

You can reuse the same application as the official Tesla Fleet integration.
